
## Install

> [!NOTE]
> Mitra isn't on Google Play, so Android asks you to confirm before installing it. That's
> expected; all of the source is here to check.

1. On your phone, download **Mitra-for-MirAIe-<version>.apk** below.
2. Open it. If Android asks, allow your browser (or Files app) to **install unknown apps**, then
   go back and tap **Install**. If Google Play Protect warns that it doesn't recognise the app,
   tap **More details ▸ Install anyway**.
3. Open Mitra for MirAIe and sign in with your MirAIe mobile number or email, or try the demo.

**Updating?** Download and install the new APK over the old one; you stay signed in.

Requires Android 8.0 or later.
